description: The fixed set of Tidewick merchants (tenants). Same at every scale factor. size_rank 1 = largest (volume share is Zipf-shaped, exponent set by the simulator). status is the state at the end of the window (2025-12-31).

merchants.name: Marrowby & Vane
merchants.notes: UK fashion. Switches from Albion Parcel to Kennet Freight on 2025-11-24 (S1).

merchants.name: Fennel & Flint
merchants.notes: Kitchen and home; defective lot of its own-brand 5L stand mixer in spring 2025 (S5).

merchants.name: Cragsley Outfitters
merchants.notes: Largest merchant. Outdoor apparel; runs the S11 checkout experiment.

merchants.name: Ballycorran Industrial Supply
merchants.notes: B2B wholesaler; loses 2 of 5 support agents in Aug-Sep 2025 (S9).

merchants.name: Ampfeld Elektronik
merchants.notes: Electronics; preferred supplier lead time blows up from July 2025 (S4).

merchants.name: Brennquell Kaffee
merchants.notes: Largest coffee-subscription merchant; ~18% price increase on 2025-04-01 (S6).

merchants.name: Kontor24 Bürobedarf
merchants.notes: Office-equipment wholesaler; price war and pipeline slump in 2025 (S20).

merchants.name: Studio Vrij
merchants.notes: Influencer 'Spring Mega Sale' with a 40% coupon in May 2025 (S7).

merchants.name: Cinder Peak Sports Co.
merchants.notes: Sports; launches a mobile app on 2025-05-15 (S10).

merchants.name: Linden & Loom
merchants.notes: Holiday gift guide, bundles and gift cards Nov 2024 - Jan 2025 (S18).

merchants.name: Wiesgrund Wohnen
merchants.notes: ERP integration writes Berlin local time as UTC from 2024-10-27 (S13).

merchants.name: Gratlinie Outdoor
merchants.notes: Charges German instead of Austrian VAT on AT orders in Q3 2024 (S17).

merchants.name: Kibblewick
merchants.notes: Migrated in Feb 2024; its customer re-import created duplicates (S14).

merchants.name: Thistlecombe
merchants.notes: Fast-growing; sloppy catalog onboarding hurts conversion in 2025 (S19).
